updateNote: Removed the old per-category tool cap and expanded coverage with more free tools from Google and other developers: added Playground AI, Google Flow (video), Google AI Studio Build mode (app building), Gemini Code Assist + Amazon Q Developer (coding), Dify + Flowise (agents/automation), Wordtune (writing), Google Stitch (design, beta access limited in some countries), and TTSMaker (voice). Also updated Figma's free tier to include its 150 AI credits/day (500/month) allowance.

categories.title: Top AI Image Generation Tools
categories.blurb: Create logos, product shots, social graphics and brand imagery — free or with recurring credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: Google Gemini (Nano Banana 2)
tools.why: The best all-around free image generator — about 20 images a day at up to 1K resolution, no credit card needed, just a Google account.

tools.name: Leonardo.ai
tools.why: The most generous daily reload of any dedicated image tool — 150 credits every 24 hours with commercial-use rights, signup is email-only.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.why: Still the best free option when your image needs readable text — labels, quotes, headlines — refreshed daily with no card on file.

tools.name: Freepik AI
tools.why: A huge existing stock-asset library paired with a genuinely daily-reloading AI generator, handy if you already source imagery from Freepik.

tools.name: Playground AI
tools.why: One of the largest free daily allowances of any image tool, bundled with a full editor (background remover, mockups, logo maker) built around the results.

tools.name: Bing Image Creator
tools.why: A Reddit favorite for no-friction, DALL·E-quality images — a weekly batch of fast generations plus unlimited slower-queue images after, with just a Microsoft account.

tools.name: Flux (Black Forest Labs)
tools.why: Open-source and genuinely unlimited if you self-host (12GB+ GPU) — no account, no card, no recurring limit at all.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.why: The safest pick for client-facing commercial work — trained only on licensed Adobe Stock content, though the monthly allowance is thin.

categories.title: Top AI Video Generation Tools
categories.blurb: Turn ideas and images into short-form video for reels, ads and product demos — recurring free credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.why: The benchmark free video tool right now — 66 credits reset every 24 hours, no card required, on one of the most commercially proven video models.

tools.name: Google Veo 3
tools.why: Frontier-quality, sound-native video inside the free Gemini app — 50 credits a day is the easiest way to test cinematic AI video at no cost.

tools.name: Google Flow
tools.why: Google's dedicated AI filmmaking studio for Veo 3.1 — storyboarding, camera controls and shot-to-shot consistency that the plain Gemini app doesn't offer, with credits that reload every day. Note: the daily allowance varies significantly by country — around 50 credits/day (~12 clips) in most places, but up to 180/day has been reported in India, Brazil and parts of Southeast Asia.
tools.freeDetails: ~50 credits/day (~12 clips) in most countries, up to 180/day in some regions; availability and limits vary by country

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.why: A consistently top-ranked free tier for clip quality, with a full daily reload rather than a one-time trial.

tools.name: Pika
tools.why: Fun, social-ready clips with a real monthly reload — no card needed to sign up with email, Google or Discord.

tools.name: Hailuo AI
tools.why: Remarkably photorealistic output — especially human subjects — with a handful of free generations refreshing every day.

categories.title: Top AI Website & App Building Tools
categories.blurb: Describe your idea in plain English and get a working site or app — recurring free tokens or credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: Bolt.new
tools.why: Full-stack apps in the browser with zero setup — a real daily-and-monthly token allowance instead of a one-time trial.

tools.name: Lovable
tools.why: The most beginner-friendly idea-to-app builder — daily credits mean you can keep coming back without ever entering payment details.

tools.name: v0 by Vercel
tools.why: The best free option for polished landing pages and UI — produces production-grade React/Tailwind you can deploy straight to Vercel.

tools.name: Replit
tools.why: Cloud IDE plus an AI agent that handles multi-step builds — a genuine monthly allowance of dev time and AI completions to learn on.

tools.name: Base44
tools.why: Popular with non-technical founders for going from prompt to working app fast, with credits that renew every month.

tools.name: Dyad
tools.why: A free, open-source app builder that runs on your own machine — no signup, no card, and your code stays private by default.

tools.name: Google AI Studio (Build mode)
tools.why: Google's free 'vibe coding' surface — describe an app in plain English and Gemini assembles a working React/Tailwind or native Android app, with free Cloud Run deployment for new builders and no card on file.
tools.freeDetails: Free, no card required; includes free Cloud Run deployment for new builders

categories.title: Top AI Coding Assistant Tools
categories.blurb: In-editor AI pair programmers that autocomplete, refactor and chat through your codebase — recurring free quotas, no credit card required.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.why: The dominant AI-native code editor right now — a real monthly allowance of completions and premium requests on the free Hobby tier.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot Free
tools.why: The highest-rated coding assistant on G2/Capterra, with a genuinely free monthly tier bundled straight into your GitHub account.

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.why: Unlimited autocomplete plus a recurring agent quota make this a strong Copilot alternative for founders coding solo.
tools.freeDetails: Unlimited Tab autocomplete + recurring Cascade quota

tools.name: Cline
tools.why: Free and open source with no platform credits to run out of — bring your own API key and it runs in VS Code or JetBrains indefinitely.
tools.freeDetails: Free & open source (bring your own API key)

tools.name: Google Jules
tools.why: Google's async coding agent hands off whole tasks — bug fixes, PRs — for free every day with just a Google account.

tools.name: Gemini CLI
tools.why: The lowest-friction way to get an AI coding agent in your terminal — genuinely free with no account required for basic use.
tools.freeDetails: Free, no account required for basic use

tools.name: Gemini Code Assist
tools.why: By far the largest free coding quota available anywhere — roughly 90x GitHub Copilot's free tier — running on Gemini 2.5 Pro inside VS Code, JetBrains and Android Studio.

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
tools.why: AWS's free coding assistant — unlimited inline suggestions plus a recurring monthly quota of agentic tasks, signed up for free with just an AWS Builder ID (no AWS account or card needed).

categories.title: Top AI Agents & Automation Tools
categories.blurb: Automate repetitive busywork and build AI agents that run your workflows — recurring free tasks or credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: n8n
tools.why: The most popular open-source automation platform — self-host the Community Edition for unlimited workflows at zero cost (n8n's own cloud free tier has since been discontinued).
tools.freeDetails: Free self-hosted Community Edition, unlimited executions

tools.name: Zapier
tools.why: 8,000+ app connections and the easiest on-ramp for non-technical teams, with a permanent free plan that renews every month.

tools.name: Latenode
tools.why: Free tier is priced in raw compute (CPU-seconds) rather than opaque credits, so simple workflows stretch further before you hit a paywall.

tools.name: Activepieces
tools.why: An open-source Zapier alternative with a genuinely free cloud tier, or self-host the Community Edition for unlimited automations.
tools.freeDetails: 1,000 tasks + 200 AI credits/month (cloud); unlimited if self-hosted

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.why: A visual agent builder with one of the more generous monthly credit allowances for building real automations without paying.

tools.name: Lindy
tools.why: An "AI employee" builder popular on r/nocode for handling email, scheduling and support — 400 credits renew every month.

tools.name: Botpress
tools.why: A well-regarded platform for building support and sales chatbots, with a pay-as-you-go free plan that never requires a card to start.

tools.name: Dify
tools.why: A production-grade open-source platform for building RAG-powered agents and workflows — self-host the Community Edition for free with no usage caps and full data control.
tools.freeDetails: Free self-hosted Community Edition, unlimited usage

tools.name: Flowise
tools.why: A LangChain-based drag-and-drop agent builder under a permissive MIT license — free to self-host and use commercially with no restrictions.

categories.title: Top AI Writing & Copywriting Tools
categories.blurb: Draft ad copy, landing pages, emails and blog posts faster — recurring free words or prompts, no credit card required.

tools.name: Copy.ai
tools.why: Consistently named the best free AI writer for marketing copy, with 90+ templates for ads, social and email.

tools.name: Rytr
tools.why: The most generous true-free AI writer for short-form copy, covering 40+ use cases and 20+ tones.

tools.name: Writesonic
tools.why: A favorite in SEO and content-marketing circles for its template range and built-in SEO checker, on a free plan that renews monthly.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.why: One of the most-recommended free rewriting and editing tools on Reddit and G2 — unlimited paraphrasing plus 50 AI prompts every day.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.why: Free writing cleanup everywhere you type — still the near-universal recommendation for a quick quality upgrade on customer-facing copy.
tools.freeDetails: Free tier with unlimited core suggestions

tools.name: Wordtune
tools.why: The most-recommended free AI rewriting tool for tightening tone and clarity sentence-by-sentence, rather than generating copy from scratch.

categories.title: Top AI Design Tools
categories.blurb: Brand kits, social templates and design assistance for founders without a design team — recurring free credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: Canva
tools.why: Still the #1 design tool for non-designers — a genuinely permanent free tier plus Magic Studio AI credits that renew monthly.
tools.freeDetails: Free forever plan + monthly Magic Studio AI credits

tools.name: Recraft
tools.why: The only major free AI tool producing true scalable SVG vectors — the go-to for logos and brand illustration.

tools.name: Adobe Express
tools.why: Adobe-quality templates and Firefly-powered generation with commercially-safe training data, on a plan that renews monthly.

tools.name: Microsoft Designer
tools.why: A free, DALL·E-powered design tool tightly integrated with Bing — fast for social graphics with just a Microsoft account.

tools.name: Figma
tools.why: The professional standard for UI and marketing design — the free Starter plan is usable indefinitely, not a trial, and now bundles daily AI credits.
tools.freeDetails: Free Starter plan (3 projects) + 150 AI credits/day (500/month), no expiry

tools.name: Google Stitch
tools.why: Google's free AI UI designer — describe an app and get a multi-screen interface exportable straight to Figma or code. Note: it's still a Google Labs beta, and access has been reported as unreliable or blocked in some countries, including Ukraine, parts of the Balkans (North Macedonia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina), the UAE, Andorra and Spain.
tools.freeDetails: 550 generations/month (350 standard + 200 Pro); access unreliable in a handful of countries

categories.title: Top AI Voice & Transcription Tools
categories.blurb: Natural AI voice-overs and accurate speech-to-text for podcasts, reels and meeting notes — recurring free minutes or characters, no credit card required.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.why: The most realistic AI voices available — 10,000 free characters a month is enough for weekly short-form voice-overs.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.why: The most-recommended free meeting-transcription tool on Reddit and G2 — 300 minutes reset every month.

tools.name: OpenAI Whisper
tools.why: Unlimited free offline transcription in 99+ languages — the open-source workhorse behind most transcription apps, free forever if self-hosted.

tools.name: Wispr Flow
tools.why: Real-time voice dictation into any app on your computer or phone — talk instead of type, with a weekly word allowance that resets every Sunday.

tools.name: Fish Audio
tools.why: A lightweight ElevenLabs alternative with a genuine monthly reload and a community library of 2M+ cloned voices.

tools.name: Descript
tools.why: An all-in-one audio/video editor with transcript-based editing — 60 free minutes a month is enough for short-form creator workflows.

tools.name: NaturalReader
tools.why: Unlimited free text-to-speech listening with standard voices — the long-standing pick for turning articles and PDFs into audio.
tools.freeDetails: Unlimited standard-voice TTS, free web app

tools.name: TTSMaker
tools.why: The most generous no-signup text-to-speech tool — a real weekly character allowance with no account required, handy for quick voice-overs without commitment.

categories.title: Top AI Music & Audio Generation Tools
categories.blurb: Generate original background music, jingles and full songs for content and ads — recurring free credits, no credit card required.

tools.name: Suno
tools.why: The consensus pick for best free AI music generator — natural-sounding vocals and the easiest prompt-to-song workflow, with credits that renew daily.

tools.name: Udio
tools.why: Praised for high-fidelity instrumentals and finer creative control than most rivals, on credits that renew monthly and daily.

tools.name: Boomy
tools.why: The fastest path from idea to finished song for non-musicians, with a monthly allowance and an optional (paid) Spotify distribution path.

tools.name: AIVA
tools.why: A long-standing favorite among indie creators for instrumental and orchestral scoring, with a free download allowance every month.

tools.freeDetails: Free tier, rolling daily/hourly message limits

tools.name: Claude
tools.why: The strongest free assistant for long documents and careful writing — paste an entire business plan and get thoughtful feedback.
tools.freeDetails: Free tier, resets on a rolling 5-hour window

tools.name: Perplexity

tools.name: Google Gemini

tools.name: NotebookLM

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.why: A genuinely free, unmetered chat assistant frequently recommended on Reddit for coding and reasoning tasks at zero cost.

tools.name: HubSpot CRM
tools.why: The strongest free CRM for founders — contacts, pipeline and email tracking free forever, no card required to start.
tools.freeDetails: Free forever core CRM (1,000 contacts, 2 users)

categories.title: AI Tools Worth Paying For
categories.blurb: When you outgrow the free tiers, these are the upgrades that actually pay for themselves.

tools.name: ChatGPT Plus
tools.why: $20/month removes the limits on your most-used assistant — priority access, advanced models and heavier custom-GPT usage.

tools.name: Claude Pro
tools.why: $20/month for much higher limits on the best long-document assistant — worth it the week you start writing serious content.

tools.name: Canva Pro
tools.why: $15/month unlocks the brand kit, background remover and premium templates — the single best value upgrade for solo founders.

tools.name: Google AI Pro
tools.why: $19.99/month bundles Gemini's top models, Veo video credits and 2TB storage — the broadest AI bundle per dollar.

tools.name: Kling AI Pro
tools.why: Paid tiers unlock 1080p, longer clips and commercial licensing on the most production-ready video model.
